=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:449-477 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: discover_identity_source_prompt checks prompt_path.parent.name before resolving prompt_path, so relative paths can skip the _templates/prompts special-casing and miss canonical prompts.
  WHY: A relative prompt path changes the parent-directory name seen by the lookup, altering discovery ordering and potentially returning None or the wrong canonical prompt.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:627-631 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: apply_identity_recall passes the wrapper prompt_path to render_identity_recall_block instead of canonical_prompt_path, so identity-recall template discovery is rooted in the wrong tree.
  WHY: When the caller uses a temp or inline wrapper path, discover_identity_recall_template_path can search the wrong repo root or fail to find the template.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:182-184 and 313 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: IDENTITY_RECALL_INJECTED_FILE is read in cleanup/dispatch logic but is never set by the script, so an externally exported value can trigger unintended deletion and control-flow changes.
  WHY: The EXIT trap will rm -f the supplied path on exit, and the dispatch guard can short-circuit rendering when the env var is present.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:233-241 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: _env_flag_enabled now treats any non-empty, non-false string as truthy, broadening the set of values that enable identity recall.
  WHY: Mistyped or non-standard values can now activate the feature instead of being treated as disabled; reviewers disagreed on severity, with one calling it NIT and others MAJOR.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:486-518 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: extract_identity_recall_metadata changed from an optional-return API to raising IdentityRecallParseError on failure, removing the previous None sentinel contract.
  WHY: In-repo callers were updated, but external consumers of the old API would now see an unhandled exception instead of a None result.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:68-78,545 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: public module identifiers were removed or renamed without deprecation shims, breaking external importers of the old API surface.
  WHY: External code importing the removed names or expecting the old apply_identity_recall_block symbol will fail at import or call time.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:604-607 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: emit_identity_reinject_parse_fail only replaces newlines in detail strings, so other characters can still confuse downstream log parsing.
  WHY: Unquoted or unsanitized detail content can make the IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL line ambiguously parseable.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The canonical-load-failure regression coverage should exercise the `canonical_prompt_load_failed` fail-open path deterministically under both unprivileged local runs and the root-default validation container, without requiring any production behavior change in `scripts/render_prompt.py`."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py (and supporting parity in tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh if extended); scripts/run_validation_repo_checks.sh or validation/tests/40_repo_checks.sh if the container environment needs a non-chmod gate.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The diff (and the LAST RUN DIFF on scripts/worktree_registry.sh) only replaces the test's subprocess calls with a synthetic PromptLoadError patch inside a temp copy of render_prompt.py; the original nondeterministic os.chmod(canonical_prompt, 0) + finally: restore block remains, the Docker app container (default root user) still cannot reliably hit the failure path, and no production renderer change was supposed to occur per the issue diagnosis.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:449-452 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: discover_identity_source_prompt evaluates prompt_path.parent.name without first resolving prompt_path, so relative prompt paths can skip the _templates and prompts special-casing.
  WHY: A relative prompt_path leaves parent.name empty, which changes discovery ordering and can miss valid canonical prompts.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:627-631 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: render_identity_recall_block is called with prompt_path=prompt_path instead of the canonical prompt path.
  WHY: Template discovery then keys off a temporary or inline wrapper file rather than the canonical prompt's repository tree.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:182-184 and 313 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: IDENTITY_RECALL_INJECTED_FILE is referenced in cleanup/dispatch logic but is never set anywhere in the script or repository.
  WHY: If externally exported, the EXIT trap can rm -f that path and the dispatch guard can short-circuit normal rendering.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:233-237 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: _env_flag_enabled now treats any non-empty, non-false string as truthy, broadening the accepted values.
  WHY: Values such as `foo` or a typo like `ture` can now enable identity recall unexpectedly.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:486-518 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: extract_identity_recall_metadata changed from returning None on failure to raising IdentityRecallParseError.
  WHY: No in-repo runtime breakage exists, but external consumers of the old optional-return API would see an unhandled exception.
